paper_code_commit_note: The controlled evaluator changes are present in the working tree but could not be committed in this sandbox; verify the GitHub commit after publishing.

software.lightglue_source: local LightGlue implementation; weights named superpoint_v1.pth and superpoint_lightglue_v0-1_arxiv.pth

notes: Dataset images, pair files, model weights, and cached LightGlue packets are intentionally excluded because of size and licensing.
The pair metadata hashes identify the exact local protocols used for the paper tables.
All filtered selectors output exactly K = min(N, max(20, round(0.95*N))) matches.
CSMR freezes its newly empty-cell target sequence from the initial Top-95% anchor; replacements update occupancy counts but do not rebuild or prune that sequence.
paper_code_commit and paper_reference_results.json identify the implementation snapshot used for paper-result reproduction; later reporting-only commits do not redefine that snapshot.
Random-95% uses seeds 17, 29, and 41 combined with the pair index as seed = 1000003 * seed + pair index.

scripts/evaluate_cached.py records its actual command arguments, current code commit, environment, selected-index signatures, pose reuse flags, and AUC@5/@10/@20 paired-bootstrap intervals in summary.json.
The controlled accuracy protocol caches one PoseLib result per unique selected-index set within each image pair; identical match sets therefore cannot receive different stochastic RANSAC outcomes.
The released per-pair CSV files and bootstrap_summary.json are derived evaluation outputs; raw images, weights, and cached packets remain excluded.
